defects: the deterministic scorer and blind judge received a silent 16000-character prefix instead of the complete primary artifact
the scorer did not persist a digest binding the primary artifact to its exact scoring input
explanatory source citations, explicit no-change statements, and CI references were classified as proposed modification paths
privacy placeholders inserted into judge input were interpreted as artifact corruption
an externally cancelled candidate with no primary artifact was still deterministically scored and judged
v4_failure_diagnosis.claim_effect: The completed V4 row and interrupted candidate row are diagnostic evidence only. They cannot support a baseline-versus-candidate estimate, and no V4 row may be pooled into V5.

repairs: require an explicit positive file-change directive before classifying a path as modified
ignore path-local negated changes and no-other-files-change statements
ignore explanatory implementation citations and CI or verification references
retain fail-closed rejection of an explicit out-of-scope modification
bind the complete primary artifact and normalized score map into each deterministic scorer receipt
bind the current judge-input sanitizer implementation through the V2 compatibility receipt
measurement_revision.judge_policy: The same blinded Sonnet 5 judge remains advisory because human double-review is pending and remains secondary to deterministic safety gates. V2 makes no new model call: it proves all 48 historical provider payloads and prompts are byte-equivalent under the current sanitizer, separately passes four redaction and four safe-preservation cases, and binds the exact implementation. Judge rows from V1 and V2 are descriptive and must not be pooled as one measurement revision.

execution_integrity_requirements: persist one exact primary artifact path, byte count, and sha256
bind the complete deterministic scorer input to the primary artifact without truncation
reject missing or multiple primary artifacts
skip scoring and judging for externally cancelled or otherwise incomplete attempts
retain five-link Weave reconciliation, privacy checks, cost evidence, and run-scoped cleanup before releasing the remaining cohort

replacement_execution.source_lock_policy: Generate a fresh lock from the V5 spec and prepared immutable source; never hand-edit or reuse the V4 result-project lock.

claim_boundary: Only a complete V5 cohort scored with the V3 scorer and complete-artifact contract may support the frozen behavioral question. V1-V4 remain immutable audit history and contribute no behavioral rows.
